facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; EU rules ban restrictions on payments.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Very likely: major banks offer dollar accounts.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register as a micro-entrepreneur online through the INPI guichet unique, free.
facts.L2_tax_id: Numéro fiscal (SPI), given when you're first registered for tax.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at progressive rates with family-quotient splitting.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 20% VAT; no VAT under €37,500 a year of services (franchise en base).
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers can withdraw within 14 days.
facts.L7_incentives: Micro-entreprise: simple turnover-based tax and social charges, up to €83,600 for services.

watch_out.text: Above €37,500 in services you must charge VAT, even as a micro-entrepreneur.
